title: A really cheap way to get really smart lights
author: Jay Peters

recommendations.name: Hue Essentials
recommendations.blurb: Philips Hue has a new lineup of cheaper smart lightbulbs starting at $25 per bulb (or $15 each as part of a four-pack), making them much cheaper than its flagship color-changing bulbs. Parent company Signify also announced a new bridge, more new lights , and a wired video doorbell .

recommendations.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
recommendations.blurb: Team Cherry’s years-in-the-making Hollow Knight sequel is finally here, and early indications all point to it being a worthy follow-up. There’s still a lot to discover about it, but if you figure out who Stardew Valley creator Eric Barone voices in the game , can you let me know?

recommendations.name: Instagram for iPad
recommendations.blurb: Nearly 15 years after Instagram initially launched for iOS, the social network now has an official iPad app. But the app has a video-focused twist: when you open it up, the app shows you a feed of short-form Reels. Android tablets will be getting the new design soon, Meta says.

recommendations.name: The Paper
recommendations.blurb: Peacock’s spinoff of The Office debuted in a big batch drop this week, and apparently it’s actually good , even if it takes a few episodes to hit its stride. It’s already been renewed for a second season , too.

recommendations.name: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE
recommendations.blurb: Samsung has a new model in its more affordable FE line, with the S25 FE taking some inspiration from the S25 Edge by being thinner and lighter than its predecessor. The company also launched new S11 and S11 Ultra tablets with a redesigned S Pen.

recommendations.name: Remarkable Paper Pro Move
recommendations.blurb: Remarkable has a new E Ink digital notepad, and with a skinny 7.3-inch screen, it’s one you can theoretically drop into your pocket. I’m a big fan of small paper notebooks, so the idea of using an E Ink one seems really fun to me.

recommendations.name: Chipolo’s Loop
recommendations.blurb: This item tracker and Chipolo’s new Card tracker both have rechargeable batteries instead of requiring replacements. They’ll last up to six months on a charge and work with Apple’s Find My and Google’s Find Hub networks.

recommendations.name: Mophie Max Headphones Charging Stand
recommendations.blurb: Mophie’s new charging stand is designed to charge your AirPods Max and AirPods Pro (or another Qi-compatible device) simultaneously. To charge the AirPods Max, you’ll plug in a USB-C dongle and plop the headphones into the stand, which will automatically put them into sleep mode.

recommendations.name: I have an iPhone 15 Pro
recommendations.blurb: The phone: I have an iPhone 15 Pro.

recommendations.name: Home Assistant Connect ZWA-2
recommendations.blurb: AI! Claude Code is amazing. Being able to have it work on an issue while I’m in meetings and quickly giving it some feedback between meetings has made me finish things I wouldn’t have had time for otherwise.

recommendations.name: indie game
recommendations.blurb: Some sequel to an indie game about a bug.

recommendations.name: documentary over the weekend about Python
recommendations.blurb: I came across a documentary over the weekend about Python , the programming language, and thought it was worth sharing. I’m not a developer myself, but I found it really engaging.

recommendations.name: Reeder
recommendations.blurb: This week I wasted time trying out a new RSS app. It was not quite working so I ended up adding a load of side services until I realised that my existing solution does all these things better. So I just want to give some extra love to Reeder . Everything I need in an RSS reader app.

recommendations.name: Archimarathon
recommendations.blurb: I’ve become a big fan of architecture and interior design videos. It’s so fascinating seeing the walk-throughs and hearing commentary of the architects and designers about their own works and of notable works from others.

recommendations.name: Static Dress
recommendations.blurb: Super into this (relatively) new post-hardcore band Static Dress . Particularly their newest song ‘face.’ It’s just peak 2000’s screamy music with modern production and sensibilities. Really great all around.

recommendations.blurb: Listening to NTS Radio lately. Great DJ mix shows. Incredible, never paid for something faster. App is solid. The NTS Breakfast Show w/ Flo is very popular and that seems earned!
